By that [[Time/Legends|time]], he had been connected to [[Life support/Legends|life support]] [[Computer/Legends|computers]] of the [[Avenel Rest Station]] [[Medic/Legends|medical]] wing due to having had a severe case of muscle atrophy after prolonged use of [[Myostim unit|myostim]] muscle-massaging units.<ref name="Gundark" />
